description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Across the Jordan, in the fortieth year, Moses speaks to all Israel. He recalls the journey from Horeb, the appointing of judges, and the people's refusal to enter the land after the scouts' report.
1.sw: Ng'ambo ya Yordani, katika mwaka wa arobaini, Musa anasema na Israeli wote. Anakumbuka safari kutoka Horebu, kuwekwa kwa waamuzi, na jinsi watu walivyokataa kuingia katika nchi baada ya taarifa ya wapelelezi.
1.am: በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ፣ በአርባኛው ዓመት ሙሴ ለእስራኤል ሁሉ ይናገራል። ከኮሬብ የተደረገውን ጕዞ፣ የዳኞችን መሾምና ሰላዮቹ ከመለሱት ወሬ በኋላ ሕዝቡ ወደ ምድሪቱ ለመግባት እንቢ ማለታቸውን ያስታውሳል።

2.en: Moses recalls how Israel passed by Edom, Moab and Ammon without fighting them, and defeated Sihon king of Heshbon.
2.sw: Musa anakumbuka jinsi Israeli walivyopita karibu na Edomu, Moabu na Amoni bila kupigana nao, na kumshinda Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni.
2.am: ሙሴ እስራኤል ከኤዶም፣ ከሞዓብና ከአሞን ጋር ሳይዋጋ እንዴት እንዳለፈና የሐሴቦንን ንጉሥ ሴዎንን እንዴት እንዳሸነፈ ያስታውሳል።

3.en: Israel defeats Og king of Bashan, and the land east of the Jordan is given to Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh. Moses pleads to cross the Jordan but is allowed only to see the land.
3.sw: Israeli wanamshinda Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, na nchi iliyo mashariki ya Yordani inapewa Reubeni, Gadi na nusu ya Manase. Musa anaomba kuvuka Yordani lakini anaruhusiwa tu kuiona nchi.
3.am: እስራኤል የባሳንን ንጉሥ ዐግን ያሸንፋል፤ ከዮርዳኖስ በስተ ምሥራቅ ያለው ምድርም ለሮቤል፣ ለጋድና ለምናሴ እኩሌታ ይሰጣል። ሙሴ ዮርዳኖስን ለመሻገር ይለምናል፤ የተፈቀደለት ግን ምድሪቱን ማየት ብቻ ነው።

4.en: Moses urges Israel to listen to the statutes and rulings and never to make an idol, for they saw no form when God spoke from the fire. If they turn away they will be scattered, but God will not forget them; three cities of refuge are set apart across the Jordan.
4.sw: Musa anawahimiza Israeli wasikilize amri na hukumu na wasitengeneze sanamu kamwe, kwa kuwa hawakuona umbo lolote Mungu aliposema kutoka katika moto. Wakigeuka watatawanywa, lakini Mungu hatawasahau; miji mitatu ya makimbilio inatengwa ng'ambo ya Yordani.
4.am: ሙሴ እስራኤል ሥርዓቱንና ፍርዱን እንዲሰሙ፣ ጣዖትም ፈጽሞ እንዳይሠሩ ያሳስባቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር ከእሳቱ ውስጥ በተናገረ ጊዜ ምንም መልክ አላዩምና። ቢመለሱ ይበተናሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን አይረሳቸውም፤ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ሦስት የመማጸኛ ከተሞች ይለያሉ።

5.en: Moses repeats the Ten Words that God spoke from the fire at Horeb. The people asked Moses to listen for them, and God told him to teach them all the commands.
5.sw: Musa anarudia Maneno Kumi ambayo Mungu aliyasema kutoka katika moto huko Horebu. Watu walimwomba Musa asikilize kwa niaba yao, naye Mungu alimwambia awafundishe amri zote.
5.am: ሙሴ እግዚአብሔር በኮሬብ ከእሳቱ ውስጥ የተናገራቸውን አሥሩን ቃላት ይደግማል። ሕዝቡ ሙሴ በእነርሱ ፋንታ እንዲሰማ ለመኑት፤ እግዚአብሔርም ትእዛዛቱን ሁሉ እንዲያስተምራቸው ነገረው።

6.en: Moses calls Israel to hear that their God is one and to love God with all their heart, soul and strength, and teach these words to their children. When they prosper in the land they must not forget God, and when a son asks, they must tell of the rescue from Egypt.
6.sw: Musa anawaita Israeli wasikie kwamba Mungu wao ni mmoja, na wampende Mungu kwa moyo wao wote, kwa roho yao yote na kwa nguvu zao zote, na kuwafundisha watoto wao maneno haya. Watakapofanikiwa katika nchi hawapaswi kumsahau Mungu, na mwana atakapouliza, lazima wasimulie kuokolewa kutoka Misri.
6.am: ሙሴ እስራኤል አምላካቸው አንድ መሆኑን እንዲሰሙ፣ እግዚአብሔርን በፍጹም ልባቸው፣ በፍጹም ነፍሳቸውና በፍጹም ኃይላቸው እንዲወዱ፣ እነዚህንም ቃላት ለልጆቻቸው እንዲያስተምሩ ይጠራቸዋል። በምድሪቱ በበለጸጉ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን መርሳት የለባቸውም፤ ልጅም በጠየቀ ጊዜ ከግብፅ ስለ መዳናቸው ሊነግሩት ይገባል።

7.en: Israel must destroy the nations of the land and not marry among them. God chose Israel not because they were many but out of love, so they must not be afraid of these nations.
7.sw: Israeli lazima waangamize mataifa ya nchi na wasioane nao. Mungu aliwachagua Israeli si kwa sababu walikuwa wengi bali kwa upendo, kwa hiyo wasiyaogope mataifa hayo.
7.am: እስራኤል የምድሪቱን ሕዝቦች ሊያጠፋ ይገባል፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር ጋብቻ መፈጸም የለበትም። እግዚአብሔር እስራኤልን የመረጠው ስለ በዙ ሳይሆን ከፍቅሩ የተነሣ ነው፤ ስለዚህ እነዚህን ሕዝቦች መፍራት የለባቸውም።

8.en: Moses tells Israel to remember how God humbled and fed them in the wilderness, so they would know that people do not live on bread alone. In a good land they must not forget God or think their own strength made them rich.
8.sw: Musa anawaambia Israeli wakumbuke jinsi Mungu alivyowanyenyekeza na kuwalisha jangwani, ili wajue kwamba mtu haishi kwa mkate peke yake. Katika nchi nzuri hawapaswi kumsahau Mungu wala kudhani kwamba nguvu zao wenyewe ndizo zilizowatajirisha.
8.am: ሙሴ ሰው በእንጀራ ብቻ እንደማይኖር እንዲያውቁ እግዚአብሔር በምድረ በዳ እንዴት እንዳዋረዳቸውና እንደ መገባቸው እንዲያስታውሱ ይነግራቸዋል። በመልካሚቱ ምድር እግዚአብሔርን መርሳት ወይም በገዛ ኃይላቸው እንደ በለጸጉ ማሰብ የለባቸውም።

9.en: God gives Israel the land not because they are righteous but because of the wickedness of the nations. Moses recalls the calf of gold and how he pleaded for the people.
9.sw: Mungu anawapa Israeli nchi si kwa sababu wao ni wenye haki bali kwa sababu ya uovu wa mataifa. Musa anakumbuka ndama wa dhahabu na jinsi alivyowaombea watu.
9.am: እግዚአብሔር ምድሪቱን ለእስራኤል የሚሰጠው ስለ ጽድቃቸው ሳይሆን ስለ ሕዝቦቹ ክፋት ነው። ሙሴ የወርቁን ጥጃና ስለ ሕዝቡ እንዴት እንደ ማለደ ያስታውሳል።

10.en: God gives Moses two new stone tablets, kept in the ark. What God asks is that Israel fear God, walk in God's ways, love and serve God, and love the outsider.
10.sw: Mungu anampa Musa vibao viwili vipya vya mawe, vinavyowekwa ndani ya sanduku. Kile ambacho Mungu anakitaka ni kwamba Israeli wamche Mungu, waende katika njia zake, wampende na kumtumikia, na wampende mgeni.
10.am: እግዚአብሔር በታቦቱ ውስጥ የሚቀመጡ ሁለት አዲስ የድንጋይ ጽላቶችን ለሙሴ ይሰጠዋል። እግዚአብሔር የሚፈልገው እስራኤል እርሱን እንዲፈሩ፣ በመንገዱ እንዲሄዱ፣ እንዲወዱትና እንዲያገለግሉት፣ መጻተኛውንም እንዲወዱ ነው።

11.en: Israel must love God and keep the commands, remembering what God did in Egypt and the wilderness. The land drinks in rain from heaven, and Moses sets before them a blessing and a curse.
11.sw: Israeli lazima wampende Mungu na kushika amri, wakikumbuka yale Mungu aliyoyatenda Misri na jangwani. Nchi inanywa mvua kutoka mbinguni, naye Musa anaweka mbele yao baraka na laana.
11.am: እስራኤል እግዚአብሔር በግብፅና በምድረ በዳ ያደረገውን እያስታወሱ እግዚአብሔርን ሊወዱና ትእዛዛቱን ሊጠብቁ ይገባል። ምድሪቱ ከሰማይ ዝናብን ትጠጣለች፤ ሙሴም በረከትንና መርገምን በፊታቸው ያኖራል።

12.en: Israel must destroy the nations' places of worship and bring offerings only to the place God will choose. They may eat meat in their towns but not the blood, and must not follow the ways of the nations.
12.sw: Israeli lazima waharibu mahali pa ibada pa mataifa na kuleta sadaka mahali tu ambapo Mungu atapachagua. Wanaweza kula nyama katika miji yao lakini si damu, na hawapaswi kufuata njia za mataifa.
12.am: እስራኤል የሕዝቦቹን የአምልኮ ስፍራዎች ሊያጠፋ፣ መባዎችንም እግዚአብሔር በሚመርጠው ስፍራ ብቻ ሊያቀርብ ይገባል። በከተሞቻቸው ሥጋ ሊበሉ ይችላሉ፤ ደሙን ግን አይበሉም፤ የሕዝቦቹንም መንገድ መከተል የለባቸውም።

13.en: A prophet or dreamer who urges Israel to follow other gods must be put to death, even a close relative. A town that turns to other gods must be destroyed.
13.sw: Nabii au mwotaji wa ndoto anayewahimiza Israeli kufuata miungu mingine lazima auawe, hata akiwa jamaa wa karibu. Mji unaogeukia miungu mingine lazima uangamizwe.
13.am: እስራኤልን ሌሎች አማልክትን እንዲከተሉ የሚገፋፋ ነቢይ ወይም ሕልም አላሚ የቅርብ ዘመድ እንኳ ቢሆን ሊገደል ይገባል። ወደ ሌሎች አማልክት የዞረች ከተማም ልትጠፋ ይገባታል።

14.en: Israel are children of God and must not mourn like the nations. Rules are given for clean and unclean food, and for the yearly tithe and the tithe of the third year.
14.sw: Israeli ni watoto wa Mungu na hawapaswi kuomboleza kama mataifa. Kanuni zinatolewa kuhusu vyakula safi na najisi, na kuhusu zaka ya kila mwaka na zaka ya mwaka wa tatu.
14.am: እስራኤል የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናቸው፤ እንደ ሕዝቦቹም ማልቀስ የለባቸውም። ስለ ንጹሕና ስለ ርኩስ ምግብ፣ ስለ ዓመታዊው አሥራትና ስለ ሦስተኛው ዓመት አሥራት ሥርዓት ይሰጣል።

15.en: Every seventh year debts are released, and Israel must open its hand to the poor. Hebrew slaves go free after six years, and firstborn animals are set apart for God.
15.sw: Kila mwaka wa saba madeni yanasamehewa, na Israeli lazima wawafungulie maskini mkono wao. Watumwa Waebrania wanaachwa huru baada ya miaka sita, na wazaliwa wa kwanza wa wanyama wanatengwa kwa ajili ya Mungu.
15.am: በየሰባተኛው ዓመት ዕዳ ይሰረዛል፤ እስራኤልም ለድኻ እጁን ሊዘረጋ ይገባል። ዕብራውያን ባሪያዎች ከስድስት ዓመት በኋላ ነፃ ይወጣሉ፤ የእንስሳት በኵሮችም ለእግዚአብሔር ይለያሉ።

16.en: Israel must keep Passover, the Festival of Weeks and the Festival of Booths at the place God chooses. Judges must judge with justice and take no bribes.
16.sw: Israeli lazima washike Pasaka, Sikukuu ya Majuma na Sikukuu ya Vibanda mahali ambapo Mungu anapachagua. Waamuzi lazima wahukumu kwa haki na wasipokee rushwa.
16.am: እስራኤል ፋሲካን፣ የሳምንታት በዓልንና የዳስ በዓልን እግዚአብሔር በሚመርጠው ስፍራ ሊያከብሩ ይገባል። ዳኞች በቅንነት ሊፈርዱ፣ ጉቦም ሊቀበሉ አይገባም።

17.en: Anyone who serves other gods must be put to death on the word of two or three witnesses, and hard cases go to the priests and judge. A king must not multiply horses, wives or wealth, and must read the law all his life.
17.sw: Mtu yeyote anayetumikia miungu mingine lazima auawe kwa ushahidi wa mashahidi wawili au watatu, na mashauri magumu yanapelekwa kwa makuhani na kwa mwamuzi. Mfalme hapaswi kujiongezea farasi, wake wala mali, na lazima aisome sheria maisha yake yote.
17.am: ሌሎች አማልክትን የሚያመልክ ሁሉ በሁለት ወይም በሦስት ምስክሮች ቃል ሊገደል ይገባል፤ አስቸጋሪ ጉዳዮችም ወደ ካህናቱና ወደ ዳኛው ይሄዳሉ። ንጉሥ ፈረሶችን፣ ሚስቶችንና ሀብትን ማብዛት የለበትም፤ በሕይወት ዘመኑም ሁሉ ሕጉን ሊያነብ ይገባል።

18.en: The priests and Levites receive a portion of the offerings. Israel must not learn the ways of the nations, such as divination, and God will raise up a prophet like Moses.
18.sw: Makuhani na Walawi wanapokea sehemu ya sadaka. Israeli hawapaswi kujifunza njia za mataifa, kama vile uaguzi, naye Mungu atawainulia nabii kama Musa.
18.am: ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ ከመባዎቹ ድርሻ ይቀበላሉ። እስራኤል እንደ ሟርት ያሉትን የሕዝቦቹን መንገዶች መማር የለበትም፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ሙሴ ያለ ነቢይ ያስነሣላቸዋል።

19.en: Israel must set apart cities of refuge for those who kill accidentally, but not for murderers. They must not move boundary markers, and a false witness receives the penalty he intended.
19.sw: Israeli lazima watenge miji ya makimbilio kwa ajili ya wale wanaoua bila kukusudia, lakini si kwa ajili ya wauaji. Hawapaswi kuhamisha alama za mipaka, na shahidi wa uongo anapata adhabu aliyokusudia kwa mwenzake.
19.am: እስራኤል ሳያውቁ ሰው ለገደሉ የመማጸኛ ከተሞችን ሊለይ ይገባል፤ ለነፍሰ ገዳዮች ግን አይደለም። የድንበር ምልክቶችን ማንቀሳቀስ የለባቸውም፤ ሐሰተኛ ምስክርም በሌላው ላይ ያሰበውን ቅጣት ይቀበላል።

20.en: Before battle the priest encourages the army, and some men are sent home. Rules are given for attacking a city and sparing its fruit trees.
20.sw: Kabla ya vita kuhani analitia moyo jeshi, na baadhi ya wanaume wanarudishwa nyumbani. Kanuni zinatolewa kuhusu kushambulia mji na kuiacha miti yake ya matunda.
20.am: ከጦርነት በፊት ካህኑ ሠራዊቱን ያበረታታል፤ አንዳንድ ሰዎችም ወደ ቤታቸው ይመለሳሉ። ከተማን ስለ መውጋትና የፍሬ ዛፎቿን ስለ መተው ሥርዓት ይሰጣል።

21.en: Rules cover an unsolved killing, women taken captive, the right of the firstborn, and a stubborn and rebellious son. The body of a hanged man must not remain overnight.
21.sw: Kanuni zinahusu mauaji yasiyojulikana aliyeyatenda, wanawake waliotekwa, haki ya mzaliwa wa kwanza, na mwana mkaidi na mwasi. Mwili wa mtu aliyetundikwa haupaswi kubaki usiku kucha.
21.am: ሥርዓቱ ገዳዩ ስላልታወቀ ግድያ፣ ስለ ተማረኩ ሴቶች፣ ስለ በኵር መብትና ስለ እልኸኛና ዓመፀኛ ልጅ ይናገራል። የተሰቀለ ሰው ሬሳ ሌሊቱን ሙሉ ሊቆይ አይገባም።

22.en: Laws cover helping a neighbor's animals, sparing a mother bird, not mixing two kinds, charges against a bride, and adultery and rape.
22.sw: Sheria zinahusu kuwasaidia wanyama wa jirani, kumwacha ndege mama, kutochanganya aina mbili, mashtaka dhidi ya bibi arusi, na uzinzi na ubakaji.
22.am: ሕግጋቱ የባልንጀራን እንስሳት ስለ መርዳት፣ እናት ወፍን ስለ መተው፣ ሁለት ዓይነት ነገሮችን ስለ አለመቀላቀል፣ በሙሽሪት ላይ ስለሚቀርብ ክስ፣ ስለ ምንዝርና ስለ አስገድዶ መድፈር ይናገራሉ።

23.en: Some are excluded from the assembly of God. The camp must be kept holy, an escaped slave must not be returned, and vows must be paid, while a neighbor's harvest may be eaten but not carried off.
23.sw: Baadhi ya watu wanazuiliwa kuingia katika kusanyiko la Mungu. Kambi lazima iwe takatifu, mtumwa aliyetoroka hapaswi kurudishwa, na nadhiri lazima zitimizwe, na mavuno ya jirani yanaweza kuliwa lakini si kuchukuliwa.
23.am: አንዳንዶች ከእግዚአብሔር ጉባኤ ይከለከላሉ። ሰፈሩ ቅዱስ ሆኖ ሊጠበቅ ይገባል፤ ያመለጠ ባሪያ ሊመለስ አይገባም፤ ስእለትም ሊፈጸም ይገባል፤ የባልንጀራ ሰብል ሊበላ ይችላል እንጂ ተይዞ ሊወሰድ አይገባም።

24.en: Laws cover divorce and remarriage, pledges and fair wages. Israel must not deprive the outsider, the fatherless and the widow of justice, and must leave gleanings for them.
24.sw: Sheria zinahusu talaka na kuoa tena, rehani na ujira wa haki. Israeli hawapaswi kumnyima mgeni, yatima na mjane haki, na lazima wawaachie masazo ya mavuno.
24.am: ሕግጋቱ ስለ ፍቺና ስለ ዳግም ጋብቻ፣ ስለ መያዣና ስለ ትክክለኛ ደመወዝ ይናገራሉ። እስራኤል መጻተኛውን፣ ወላጅ የሌለውንና መበለቲቱን ፍትሕ መንፈግ የለበትም፤ ቃርሚያንም ሊተውላቸው ይገባል።

25.en: A guilty man may receive no more than forty strokes. A brother must marry his dead brother's widow, Israel must use honest weights and measures, and must remember what Amalek did.
25.sw: Mtu mwenye hatia hawezi kupigwa zaidi ya viboko arobaini. Ndugu lazima amwoe mjane wa ndugu yake aliyekufa, Israeli lazima watumie mizani na vipimo vya haki, na lazima wakumbuke yale Amaleki aliyoyatenda.
25.am: ጥፋተኛ ሰው ከአርባ ግርፋት በላይ ሊገረፍ አይገባም። ወንድም የሞተውን ወንድሙን መበለት ሊያገባ ይገባል፤ እስራኤል ትክክለኛ ሚዛንና መስፈሪያ ሊጠቀም፣ አማሌቅ ያደረገውንም ሊያስታውስ ይገባል።

26.en: In the land Israel brings the first of the harvest to God and recites how God brought them out of Egypt. Moses declares that Israel has become God's own people.
26.sw: Katika nchi Israeli wanamletea Mungu malimbuko ya mavuno na kusimulia jinsi Mungu alivyowatoa Misri. Musa anatangaza kwamba Israeli wamekuwa watu wa Mungu mwenyewe.
26.am: በምድሪቱ እስራኤል የመከሩን በኵራት ለእግዚአብሔር ያመጣል፤ እግዚአብሔር ከግብፅ እንዴት እንዳወጣቸውም ይናገራል። ሙሴ እስራኤል የእግዚአብሔር የራሱ ሕዝብ እንደ ሆነ ያውጃል።

27.en: Israel must set up stones with the law written on them and an altar on Mount Ebal. Today they have become God's people, and the Levites pronounce the curses from Mount Ebal.
27.sw: Israeli lazima wasimamishe mawe yaliyoandikwa sheria na madhabahu juu ya Mlima Ebali. Leo wamekuwa watu wa Mungu, na Walawi wanatamka laana kutoka Mlima Ebali.
27.am: እስራኤል ሕጉ የተጻፈባቸውን ድንጋዮችና መሠዊያ በጌባል ተራራ ላይ ሊያቆም ይገባል። ዛሬ የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ሆነዋል፤ ሌዋውያንም ከጌባል ተራራ መርገሞቹን ያውጃሉ።

28.en: Moses sets out the blessings that will come on Israel if they obey and the curses that will come if they do not, ending in siege and exile. These are the words of the covenant made in the land of Moab.
28.sw: Musa anaeleza baraka zitakazowajia Israeli wakitii na laana zitakazowajia wasipotii, zikiishia katika kuzingirwa na uhamisho. Haya ndiyo maneno ya agano lililofanywa katika nchi ya Moabu.
28.am: ሙሴ እስራኤል ቢታዘዙ የሚመጡባቸውን በረከቶችና ባይታዘዙ የሚመጡባቸውን መርገሞች ይዘረዝራል፤ እነዚህም በከበባና በስደት ይደመደማሉ። እነዚህ በሞዓብ ምድር የተደረገው ቃል ኪዳን ቃላት ናቸው።

29.en: Israel stands today before God to enter the covenant, and Moses warns against anyone who turns to other gods. The hidden things belong to God, but what is revealed belongs to Israel.
29.sw: Israeli wanasimama leo mbele za Mungu ili kuingia katika agano, naye Musa anaonya dhidi ya mtu yeyote anayegeukia miungu mingine. Mambo yaliyofichwa ni ya Mungu, lakini yaliyofunuliwa ni ya Israeli.
29.am: እስራኤል ዛሬ ወደ ቃል ኪዳኑ ለመግባት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቆሟል፤ ሙሴም ወደ ሌሎች አማልክት የሚዞርን ማንኛውንም ሰው ያስጠነቅቃል። የተሰወሩት ነገሮች የእግዚአብሔር ናቸው፤ የተገለጡት ግን የእስራኤል ናቸው።

30.en: If Israel turns back to God from exile, God will restore them and circumcise their hearts. The word is very near them, and Moses sets before them life and good, death and harm, and urges them to choose life.
30.sw: Israeli wakimrudia Mungu kutoka uhamishoni, Mungu atawarejesha na kuitahiri mioyo yao. Neno liko karibu sana nao, naye Musa anaweka mbele yao uzima na mema, mauti na mabaya, na kuwahimiza wachague uzima.
30.am: እስራኤል ከስደት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቢመለስ እግዚአብሔር ይመልሳቸዋል፤ ልባቸውንም ይገርዛል። ቃሉ እጅግ ቅርባቸው ነው፤ ሙሴም ሕይወትንና መልካምን፣ ሞትንና ክፉን በፊታቸው አኑሮ ሕይወትን እንዲመርጡ ያሳስባቸዋል።

31.en: Moses tells Israel that Joshua will go before them, and God commissions Joshua at the tent of meeting. Moses writes down the law and is told to write a song as a witness against the people.
31.sw: Musa anawaambia Israeli kwamba Yoshua atawatangulia, naye Mungu anamwagiza Yoshua katika Hema la Kukutania. Musa anaiandika sheria na kuambiwa aandike wimbo kuwa shahidi dhidi ya watu.
31.am: ሙሴ ኢያሱ በፊታቸው እንደሚሄድ ለእስራኤል ይነግራቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔርም በመገናኛው ድንኳን ኢያሱን ይሾመዋል። ሙሴ ሕጉን ይጽፋል፤ በሕዝቡ ላይ ምስክር እንዲሆንም መዝሙር እንዲጽፍ ይነገረዋል።

32.en: Moses speaks the song that tells of God's faithfulness and Israel's unfaithfulness. He tells them the words are their very life, and God tells him to climb Mount Nebo to die.
32.sw: Musa anaimba wimbo unaosimulia uaminifu wa Mungu na kukosa uaminifu kwa Israeli. Anawaambia kwamba maneno hayo ndiyo uzima wao wenyewe, naye Mungu anamwambia apande Mlima Nebo ili afe.
32.am: ሙሴ የእግዚአብሔርን ታማኝነትና የእስራኤልን ታማኝ አለመሆን የሚተርከውን መዝሙር ይናገራል። ቃሉ ሕይወታቸው እንደ ሆነ ይነግራቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሊሞት ወደ ናባው ተራራ እንዲወጣ ይነግረዋል።

33.en: Moses blesses the tribes of Israel one by one before his death.
33.sw: Musa anayabariki makabila ya Israeli moja moja kabla ya kifo chake.
33.am: ሙሴ ከመሞቱ በፊት የእስራኤልን ነገዶች አንድ በአንድ ይባርካል።

34.en: From Mount Nebo Moses sees the whole land, and dies in Moab, and is buried there. No prophet has risen in Israel like Moses, whom God knew face to face.
34.sw: Kutoka Mlima Nebo Musa anaiona nchi yote, anakufa huko Moabu na kuzikwa huko. Hajainuka nabii yeyote katika Israeli kama Musa, ambaye Mungu alimjua uso kwa uso.
34.am: ሙሴ ከናባው ተራራ ምድሪቱን ሁሉ ያያል፤ በሞዓብ ይሞታል፤ በዚያም ይቀበራል። እግዚአብሔር ፊት ለፊት ያወቀው እንደ ሙሴ ያለ ነቢይ በእስራኤል አልተነሣም።
